## Step 5 — Findings

```
**Finding:** Audio episodes lack any transcript markup, adjacent section, or linked transcript page. Screen reader and deaf/hard-of-hearing users cannot access the spoken content.
**WCAG:** 1.2.1 (Audio-only and Video-only Prerecorded)
**Perspective:** Auditory Access
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Content Author (primary) / Front-End Dev (secondary)
**Evidence:** Component renders `<audio ref={audioRef} src={...} />` but contains no transcript elements, `<details>` sections, or visible links. [Human verification required — cannot be confirmed from source]
**Fix:** Add a visible transcript section below the player for each episode, or provide a clearly labeled link to a dedicated transcript page. Ensure transcripts are programmatically associated with the audio element via `aria-describedby` or adjacent markup.

**Finding:** A synthesized chime auto-plays on component mount via Web Audio API without any accompanying visual indicator, toast, or text announcement. Deaf users receive no notification of the "new episode" state.
**WCAG:** 1.3.3 (Sensory Characteristics) / 4.1.3 (Status Messages)
**Perspective:** Auditory Access
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** UX Design (primary) / Front-End Dev (secondary)
**Evidence:** `handleNewEpisode` creates an `AudioContext` oscillator and calls `osc.start()` inside `useEffect` on mount. No visual DOM update or `aria-live` region accompanies the sound.
**Fix:** Replace the auditory chime with a visible toast/notification, or ensure a visual indicator appears simultaneously when the sound plays. Remove auto-playing audio unless essential to the task; if kept, pair it with a synchronous visual cue and `aria-live="polite"` announcement.

**Finding:** Informative "new episode" badge uses `role="img"` but lacks `alt`, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby`. Screen readers announce only "image" with zero context.
**WCAG:** 1.1.1 (Non-text Content)
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Severity:** CRITICAL
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) / Visual Design (secondary)
**Evidence:** `<span className="new-badge" role="img" />` (line ~238) has no accessible name attribute.
**Fix:** Add `aria-label="New episode"` or change to `role="status"` with visible text. If purely decorative, remove `role="img"` and add `aria-hidden="true"`.

**Finding:** Component wrapper is a generic `<div className="podcast-player">` with no semantic landmark regions. Screen reader users cannot quickly jump to the episode list or player controls.
**WCAG:** 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships)
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) / UX Design (secondary)
**Evidence:** Root element is `<div className="podcast-player">`. No `<main>`, `<nav>`, `<section>`, or `role` attributes present.
**Fix:** Wrap the episode list in `<nav aria-label="Episodes">` and the player controls in `<section aria-label="Playback controls">` or ensure the parent page provides appropriate landmarks.

**Finding:** Time display span uses `aria-live="off"`, preventing screen readers from announcing playback progress updates as the seek bar moves.
**WCAG:** 4.1.3 (Status Messages)
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Severity:** MINOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) / UX Design (secondary)
**Evidence:** `<span className="time-display" aria-live="off">` (line ~268) explicitly silences live updates.
**Fix:** Change `aria-live` to `"polite"` so screen readers announce time changes without interrupting the user. Alternatively, rely on focus management if the seek bar is the primary interaction point.
```
